test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What should come in the place of blank number (5)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**phantomized**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage presents a world where human concepts like "agency" and "will" are replaced by **computational governance** and **algorithmic interpellation**.
 
• "**Phantomized**" (आभासी/भ्रामक बनाना) refers to something that has been turned into a phantom—a ghost-like presence that appears to exist but lacks physical or actual substance. This fits perfectly with the final clue: "**detectable only in its strategic simulation**."
 
• If liberation is phantomized, it exists only as a shadow or a simulation within the "techno-psychic schema," rather than as a tangible reality.
 
• "**Relegated**" (Option 1) means to be dismissed to a lower position. While liberation is diminished, the text emphasizes its **simulated** nature, which "phantomized" describes more precisely.
 
• "**Aestheticized**" (Option 2) means to make something a matter of beauty or style. While plausible in some critical theories, "phantomized" better captures the "not absent but [ghost-like]" contrast the author is building.
 
• "**Emulated**" (Option 3) means to imitate. The system might emulate liberation, but the word doesn't describe the state of liberation itself in this regime as well as "phantomized" does.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

Complete Passage Segment: *In the archipelago of epistemic fracture, where coherence is a relic and continuity a performative illusion, cognition unfolds not through linear causality but via stochastic pulses of informational detritus. Within this disjunctive matrix, agency is less a property of autonomous will than a side effect of algorithmic interpellation. Every action is (1) instantiated__ not as a result of volition but as an emergent behavior-calculated, inferred, and subtly modulated by systems of predictive design. Identity, in this terrain, ceases to be ontological and becomes computational: a fluid sequence of statistical probabilities encoded and re-encoded through bio-digital feedback loops. The notion of authorship is retrofitted, no longer a site of expression but a (2) __transactional__ node in a decentralized economy of semiotic production. Language, once the principal vessel of intentionality, now functions as a carrier signal for behavioral cues-optimized not for meaning but for engagement velocity. In this regime, dissent is not censored but (3) __co-opted__ -subtly realigned to serve the centripetal logics of monetized attention. The archive is not a memory but a battleground: past and present re-stitched according to the dictates of data retention, compliance heuristics, and platformed ontology. What remains is not truth but latency: the delay between perception and its (4) __modulation__ by computational governance. Thus, power no longer manifests through prohibition, but through calibration-redefining the limits of thinkability itself. In this techno-psychic schema, liberation is not absent but (5) __phantomized__: detectable only in its strategic simulation.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Strategic Simulation:** In postmodern theory (like that of Jean Baudrillard), this refers to a "copy" that has no original—a simulation that feels more real than reality itself.
 
• **Epistemic Fracture:** The breakdown of shared knowledge and truth-seeking methods within a society.
 
• **Ontological vs. Computational:** The passage contrasts "being" (ontology) with "processing" (computation), suggesting our very existence is now defined by data.
